mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_cook_record(user_id, recipe_id, idempotency_key, rating) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recipeId}, CAST(#{key} AS uuid), #{rating}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, recipe_id, rating, cooked_at FROM recipe_cook_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = CAST(#{key} AS uuid)
mapper.sql: ((s.source_type = 'SYSTEM_HOWTOCOOK' AND s.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND s.owner_user_id IS NULL) OR (s.source_type = 'USER_CUSTOM' AND s.visibility = 'PRIVATE' AND s.owner_user_id = #{userId}))
mapper.select: SELECT count(DISTINCT c.recipe_id) FROM recipe_cook_record c JOIN recipe r ON r.id = c.recipe_id JOIN recipe_source s ON s.id = r.source_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND

WITH summary AS ( SELECT c.recipe_id, count(*) AS cook_count, max(c.cooked_at) AS last_cooked_at FROM recipe_cook_record c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.recipe_id ) SELECT r.id, r.name, r.category_code, r.summary, r.difficulty, r.estimated_minutes, (f.recipe_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_favorite, h.cook_count, h.last_cooked_at, rated.rating AS latest_rating FROM summary h JOIN recipe r ON r.id = h.recipe_id JOIN recipe_source s ON s.id = r.source_id LEFT JOIN favorite_recipe f ON f.recipe_id = r.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.rating FROM recipe_cook_record c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.recipe_id = h.recipe_id AND c.rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.cooked_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) rated ON true WHERE ORDER BY h.last_cooked_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
